hero.headline: Voice agents that follow your script and know when to hand over
hero.subheadline: We build inbound and outbound voice and WhatsApp agents in Hindi, Hinglish, English and regional languages, with consent checks, guardrails and a clean handover to your team.

intro: A good voice agent is mostly plumbing and rules: telephony, CRM lookups, consent, calling windows, escalation, and what it must never say. We build those first, then tune the conversation for your callers. Because we also red-team voice agents for a living, every agent we ship is tested against the ways callers try to push it off script.
what_we_build: WhatsApp agents with payment links and catalogues
Call QA and compliance auditing on recorded calls
how_we_work: Map the call types and the rules the agent must follow
Build on your telephony and CRM in a sandbox
Red-team the agent before it talks to customers
Launch on a slice of traffic with human handover and call review

faqs.a: Hindi, Hinglish and English are standard. Other Indian languages depend on the speech models available for your use case; the pilot tests recognition quality on your real callers.

faqs.q: How do you stop the agent saying the wrong thing?
faqs.a: Locked scripts for regulated statements, retrieval from approved content only, refusal rules, and adversarial testing before launch. Calls are recorded and sampled for review.

faqs.q: Can it transfer to a human?
faqs.a: Yes. Handover rules are agreed upfront, for example on complaints, payment disputes or low confidence, and the human agent receives a summary.
